<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Product;

use App\Domain\ProductSearchOrder;

use App\Models\Product\ProdPart;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Livewire\Attributes\On;
use Livewire\Attributes\Url;
use Livewire\Component;

class ProductList extends Component
{
    // For mask the model used on this component, see "Register morph maps" in AppServiceProvider.php

    // Per far sì che i filtri vengano sia gestiti da querystring che da Livewire, bisogna creare due proprietà per ogni filtro...
    // una per il querystring e una per Livewire, ricevendo i filtri da querystring questi verranno assegnati anche alle proprietà di Livewire e viceversa.
    // Questo permette di avere un'url pulito e di poter gestire i filtri con Livewire. La gestione dei filtri solo con Livewire genera dei link lunghi e, soprattutto, diversi per lo stesso risultato in pagina.
    #[Url]
    public ?string $category; // Filter that will be passed by querystring
    public array $fCategory = []; // Filter that will be passed by Livewire -->(same rule above for the other filters)
    #[Url]
    public string $application = '';
    public array $fApplication = [];
    #[Url]
    public ?array $diameter = [];
    public ?int $fAllDiameter = 1;
    public ?array $fDiameter = [];
    public string $diameterLabel;
    #[Url]
    public string $ip = '';
    public array $fIp = [];
    #[Url]
    public string $lumen = '';
    public array $fLumen = [];
    #[Url]
    public string $line = '';
    public array $fLine = [];
    #[Url(except: '', as: 'q')]
    public string $search = '';
    #[Url(except: '', as: 'qt')]
    public string $search_type = '';

    public Collection $products;
    public Collection $filterCategories;
    public Collection $filterIps;
    public Collection $filterLumen;
    public Collection $filterApplication;
    public array $filterDiameter = [];

    /**
     * Range of values for lens "clear_value"
     * @var array<int>
     */
    public array $lensRangeValues;

    /**
     * Current value of lens range
     * @var array<int>
     */
    #[Url]
    public array $lensRange = [];

    /**
     * Tag associati alle lenti (type_id 1)
     */
    #[Url]
    public string $lenstag = '';

    /** @var array<int,bool> */
    public array $fLenstag = [];
    /** @var Collection<int,ProdPartTag> */
    public Collection $filterLensTags;


    public Collection $filterLine;
    public Collection $categories;
    public array $downloadTypes;

    /**
     * If true, "depth/height" filter is set to "all"
     * (accordion closed)
     */
    public ?int $fAllDepthHeight = 1;

    /**
     * Min and max depth/height filter values
     * @var array<int,int>
     */
    public array $filterDepthHeightRange = [];

    /**
     * Current range set for depth/height filter
     * @var array<int,mixed>
     */
    #[Url]
    public array $depth = [];



    private array $selectedCategories = [];
    private array $publishedActiveProducts = [];
    private array $authFiltersHidden = [
        'fCategory',
        'fApplication',
        'fAllDiameter',
        'fDiameter',
        'fLenstag',
        'fIp',
        'fLumen',
        'fLine',
    ];


    public function mount(?array $querystring, Request $request)
    {
        // Assign the querystring to current filters
        // From querystring property to Livewire property
        if ($querystring) {
            $querystring = unSerializeFilter($querystring);
            foreach ($querystring as $key => $value) {
                // If the key exists in the class, set the value
                if (property_exists($this, $key)) {
                    $key = 'f'.ucfirst($key);
                    $this->{$key} = $value;
                }
            }

            // Check diameter filter values
            // If the $fDiameter is not empty, set the $fAllDiameter to 0
            if (count($this->fDiameter)) {
                $this->fAllDiameter = 0;
                // Force int values for diameter
                $this->fDiameter[0] = (int)$this->fDiameter[0];
                $this->fDiameter[1] = (int)$this->fDiameter[1];

                if (
                    $this->fDiameter[0] == 0
                    || $this->fDiameter[1] == 0
                    || $this->fDiameter[0] > $this->fDiameter[1]
                ) {
                    // If the diameter is not valid, set it to empty array
                    $this->fDiameter = [];
                    $this->fAllDiameter = 1; // Set the all diameter filter to true
                }
            }

            // if depth parameters are set, set the fAllDepthHeight to 0 (accordion open)
            if (count($this->depth)) {
                $this->fAllDepthHeight = 0;
            } else {
                $this->fAllDepthHeight = 1;
            }


        }

        // Get products
        $this->getProductList();
        // Filters lists
        $this->defineFiltersLists();

        // Define the diameter range
        if (!count($this->fDiameter)) {
            $this->fDiameter = [array_key_first($this->filterDiameter), array_key_last($this->filterDiameter)];
        }
        $this->diameterLabel = __('global.all'); // Default label for diameter, at the beginning is set to "All". This will be updated when the diameter filter is set, to numeric value or "All" again

        $this->categories = Category::published()->navigationFilter()->orderBy('sort')->get();
    }


    // Listen for the event from the view
    protected $listeners = [
        'resetFilterType' => 'resetFilterType',
        'resetFilterSingle' => 'resetFilterSingle',
        'resetFilterAll' => 'resetFilterAll',
        'updateFilterDiameter' => 'updateFilterDiameter',
    ];


    public function updateFilterDiameter(array $value)
    {
        $this->diameter = $value;
        $this->fDiameter = $value;

        // Get products
        $this->getProductList();
        // Filters lists
        $this->defineFiltersLists();
    }


    /**
     * Get ProductList with current filters
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public function getProductList()
    {
        $innerProducts = ProdWrapper::published()->navigationFilter();

        // Category
        if (count($this->fCategory)) {
            $innerProducts = $innerProducts->whereHas('category', function ($q) {
                $q->where(function ($q) {
                    foreach ($this->fCategory as $category => $value) {
                        if ($value === true) {
                            $q->orWhere('page_url->'.app()->getLocale(), $category);
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
            $this->resetSearch(); // Reset search if any filter is selected
        }


        // Application
        if (count($this->fApplication)) {
            $innerProducts = $innerProducts->whereHas('techData', function ($q) {
                $q->where(function ($q) {
                    foreach ($this->fApplication as $filter => $value) {
                        if ($value === true) {
                            $q->orWhere('id', $filter);
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
            $this->resetSearch(); // Reset search if any filter is selected
        }

        // Diameter
        if (count($this->fDiameter) && $this->fAllDiameter === 0) {
            $innerProducts = $innerProducts->whereBetween('diameter', $this->fDiameter);
            $this->resetSearch(); // Reset search if any filter is selected
        }

        // depth/height
        if (count($this->depth)) {
            $innerProducts = $innerProducts->whereBetween('depth_height', $this->depth);
            $this->resetSearch(); // Reset search if any filter is selected
        }

        // lens range ("clear_value" field)
        if (count($this->lensRange)) {
            $innerProducts = $innerProducts->whereHas('lenses', function (Builder $q) {

                // if first value is "0", do not consider min value for the query
                $q->when((int) $this->lensRange[0] == 0, function ($q) {
                    $q->where('clear_value', '<=', $this->lensRange[1]);
                }, function ($q) {
                    $q->whereBetween('clear_value', $this->lensRange);
                });

            });
            $this->resetSearch(); // Reset search if any filter is selected
        }

        // Lens tags (tag associati alle lenti, type_id 1)
        if (count($this->fLenstag)) {
            $innerProducts = $innerProducts->whereHas('lenses', function (Builder $q) {
                $q->whereHas('tags', function (Builder $q) {
                    $q->where(function (Builder $q) {
                        foreach ($this->fLenstag as $filter => $value) {
                            if ($value === true) {
                                $q->orWhere('prod_parts_tags.id', $filter);
                            }
                        }
                    });
                });
            });
            $this->resetSearch(); // Reset search if any filter is selected
        }

        // IP
        if (count($this->fIp)) {
            $innerProducts = $innerProducts->whereHas('techData', function ($q) {
                $q->where(function ($q) {
                    foreach ($this->fIp as $filter => $value) {
                        if ($value === true) {
                            $q->orWhere('page_url->'.app()->getLocale(), $filter);
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
            $this->resetSearch(); // Reset search if any filter is selected
        }

        // Lumen
        if (count($this->fLumen)) {
            $innerProducts = $innerProducts->whereHas('techData', function ($q) {
                $q->where(function ($q) {
                    foreach ($this->fLumen as $filter => $value) {
                        if ($value === true) {
                            $q->orWhere('page_url->'.app()->getLocale(), $filter);
                        }
                    }
                });
            });
            $this->resetSearch(); // Reset search if any filter is selected
        }

        // Line
        if (count($this->fLine)) {
            $innerProducts = $innerProducts->where(function ($q) {
                foreach ($this->fLine as $filter => $value) {
                    if ($value === true) {
                        $q->orWhere('line_id', $filter);
                    }
                }
            });

Ho ricostruito il quadro completo. Ecco cosa fa `wire_value` e le implicazioni.

## A cosa serve `wire_value`

In [checkbox.blade.php:14-15](resources/views/components/filtri/checkbox.blade.php#L14-L15) `wire_value` ha due ruoli:

```php
@if($wire_model) wire:model.live="{{$wire_model.'.'.$wire_value}}" @endif
@if($wire_value) value="{{$wire_value}}" @endif
```

1. **Chiave dell'array-filtro Livewire**: costruisce il binding `wire:model.live="fIp.<wire_value>"`, quindi `wire_value` diventa la **chiave** dentro `$fIp` / `$fLumen` (es. `$fIp['ip65'] = true`).
2. Valore dell'attributo `value` della checkbox.

Quella chiave viene poi riusata in [ProductList.php](app/Livewire/Product/ProductList.php) come **valore su cui filtrare la query**:

- IP → [`$q->orWhere('page_url->'.locale, $filter)`](app/Livewire/Product/ProductList.php#L290)
- Lumen → [`$q->orWhere('page_url->'.locale, $filter)`](app/Livewire/Product/ProductList.php#L304)
- e per la pulizia dei filtri non più attivi: [`firstWhere('page_url', …)`](app/Livewire/Product/ProductList.php#L513) (IP) e [L531](app/Livewire/Product/ProductList.php#L531) (Lumen)
- infine come **label dei tag attivi** in [index.blade.php:303-308](resources/views/livewire/product/index.blade.php#L303-L308).

## Il problema

Per **IP** e **Lumen** (entrambi record `ProdTechData`), `page_url` faceva da chiave/valore di query **e** da etichetta. Ora che `page_url` non è più `translatable` né castato ad array, `$ip->page_url` restituisce la stringa JSON grezza (`{"it":"...","en":"..."}`) e il filtro `page_url->locale` non funziona più come previsto.

## Sostituto naturale: `id`

Il pattern giusto esiste già nel codice: il filtro **Application** — anch'esso `ProdTechData` — usa `:wire_value="$application->id"` e filtra con `->orWhere('id', $filter)`. Basta allineare IP e Lumen allo stesso schema:

| Punto | Da | A |
|---|---|---|
| index.blade.php:191 | `$ip->page_url` | `$ip->id` |
| index.blade.php:219 | `$lumen->page_url` | `$lumen->id` |
| ProductList:290 | `page_url->locale` | `id` |
| ProductList:304 | `page_url->locale` | `id` |
| ProductList:513 | `firstWhere('page_url', …)` | `firstWhere('id', …)` |
| ProductList:531 | `firstWhere('page_url', …)` | `firstWhere('id', …)` |

**Un'unica avvertenza sul display**: i tag attivi in [index.blade.php:303-308](resources/views/livewire/product/index.blade.php#L303-L308) mostrano la chiave del filtro (`{{ $kItem }}`). Con `id` mostrerebbero un numero ("IP: 5") invece dello slug.
